title: DC-area forecast: Showers south and east this afternoon. A fabulous fall week ahead.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Showers move through areas mainly south and east of DC through midafternoon. Remaining cloudy with highs in the mid-60s.

What’s next? High pressure builds in Monday and should remain in control most of the workweek. That means plenty of sunshine and a fall feel with highs in the 60s and 70s, and cool overnight lows in the 40s to near 50.

Today’s daily digit — 6/10: Sunday spirits may be dampened by clouds, some mist, and showers in spots, but much of the day should end up decently dry. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Sunday): An area of showers tracks through areas south and east of DC through midafternoon, with highs in the mid-60s. Rain totals should be rather light, around 0.1 inches or less. Confidence: Medium-High

Radar forecast for today

Tonight: Evening readings fall back through the low 60s and upper 50s. Overcast skies hold on through the overnight with lows in the mid- to upper 50s. Confidence: High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Monday): Lingering clouds should clear from northwest to southeast during the morning. Nice and sunny by late morning and afternoon with highs in the upper 60s to low 70s. Winds are breezy from the northwest, gusting to near 25 mph. That brings increasingly drier air, dropping dew points through the 50s and possibly into the 40s. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: With clear skies and calming winds, it's the coolest night in a quite a while! Lows are mostly in the mid- to upper 40s, with some low 40s north and west of DC. Confidence: Medium

A look ahead

It's smooth sailing on Tuesday and Wednesday as high pressure dominates. Plenty of sun and light winds both days, with Tuesday highs in the mid-60s and Wednesday highs in the upper 60s to near 70. Cool nights continue with overnight lows in the 40s to near 50. Confidence: Medium-High

Thursday and Friday look sunny mostly sunny and comfortable as well, with warmer highs back into the 70s. Enjoy! Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for October 4

Tropical remnants in 1877 and 1893 brought deluges and flooding to the region, while in 1974 an early-season chill set a record low and widespread frost.
